mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) compress discount rates and boost equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.75%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC ≤ 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) above 1250 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) above $470 billion indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 470000, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes with industrial production growth exceeding 1.5% YoY, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over 60 trading days as markets anticipate peak earnings before cyclical slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances with INDPRO growth > 1.5% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) above 1250 thousand units indicate strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances with HOUST > 1250, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC ≤ 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth above 146,000 jobs signals a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.7 and PAYEMS > 146000, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In strong economic growth regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% YoY), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
